ec71544783cc8df57a814d57969228afff3ebee4.en: <t1>Torgnon</t1> is a ski resort in the <t2>Northern Alps</t2>, in <t3>Aosta Valley, Italy 🇮🇹</t3>. The ski area covers <t4>20 km of runs</t4> between 1515 m and 2246 m, served by 7 lifts. Day lift pass <t5>39€</t5> per adult.

f819d39781df95be888063d8cf8c710c8ad6fca1.fr: Le Ballon d'Alsace est une station à 1250 m, au pied du sommet éponyme (1247 m), point culminant des Vosges méridionales. Carrefour historique entre Alsace, Lorraine et Franche-Comté, ses 15 km de pistes offrent un ski familial dans un cadre naturel remarquable.
f819d39781df95be888063d8cf8c710c8ad6fca1.en: The Ballon d'Alsace is a resort at 1250 m, at the foot of the peak of the same name (1247 m), the highest point of the Southern Vosges. A historic crossroads between Alsace, Lorraine and Franche-Comté, its 15 km of runs offer family skiing in a remarkable natural setting.
